decisive_items: Blood culture positive with grayish white colonies on blood agar and green colonies on TCBS agar
fever (39°C) with obvious tenderness of the left lumbar vertebra
response.rationale: Blood culture growth on TCBS agar with green colonies is highly specific for Vibrio species, and 16S rRNA confirmation supports Vibrio vulnificus infection. Sepsis is a broader syndrome but lacks the specific microbiologic identification.

rejected.why: Only local back pain/tenderness, no microbiologic or imaging evidence of spondylitis.
Ascites cell count 200/μL is not diagnostic of SBP; cirrhosis/ascites are nonspecific.
Sepsis is a general term; the specific organism and culture findings point to Vibrio vulnificus.
